description: How many pallets fit in a given shipping container, truck trailer, rail wagon or air ULD. Use this whenever someone asks how many pallets (Euro 1200x800, standard 1200x1000, or US GMA 48x40) fit in a 20ft, 40ft, 40ft High Cube, 45ft, 53ft trailer or any other vessel. Returns the best single-layer floor count with pallets turned to their best orientation — a solved pallet-loading result, not length divided by length, so a 20ft holds 11 Euro pallets and a 40ft holds 25 — plus the double-stacked count with the load height that allows it, and how many the payload allows, which is what decides whether weight or floor space runs out first.

grossWeightKgPerPallet.description: Gross weight of one LOADED pallet, kg. Only affects the payload-limited count, which is what decides whether weight or floor space binds first.

palletType.description: Which pallet: 'euro' (1200x800mm), 'standard' (1200x1000mm), 'gma' (US 48x40in), or 'all' for every size.

vessel.description: The container, trailer, rail wagon or air ULD to load. Accepts a slug ("40ft-high-cube-container") or a plain name ("40HC", "40' high cube", "53ft trailer"). Call get_container_dimensions with no arguments for the full catalog.

name: how_many_pallets_fit

doubleStackMaxLoadHeightMm.description: Tallest a loaded pallet may be for two tiers to fit.

floorCount.description: Best single-layer count, pallets turned to their best orientation.

title: How Many Pallets Fit
